scholarships.title: JWU Global Full Tuition Scholarship (Johnson & Wales University)
scholarships.official_source: Johnson & Wales University (listed by EducationUSA, U.S. Department of State)

existing.description: A: MBA programs typically last one to two years.
eligibility: Non-US citizen applying as a new F-1 international applicant
Fully complete undergraduate application submitted by the Early Action 2 deadline
Demonstrated leadership through extracurricular, volunteer or entrepreneurial activities
Invited to apply for the scholarship through the JWU Admissions Portal
Available at the Providence and Charlotte campuses
existing.eligibility_summary: Incoming, non-US citizen, full-time undergraduate students applying as new F-1 international applicants to Johnson & Wales University, who have a complete undergraduate application by the Early Action 2 deadline and who can show demonstrated leadership through extracurricular, volunteer or entrepreneurial activities.
benefits: Full tuition coverage for eligible F-1 international undergraduates
coverage: Does not cover fees, room, board or living expenses on the evidence available
requirements: Apply to JWU for Early Action 1 or Early Action 2
Have a fully complete undergraduate application by the Early Action 2 deadline
Wait for an invitation to apply for the scholarship through the JWU Admissions Portal
application_method: Submit a JWU undergraduate application under Early Action 1 or Early Action 2
Meet the eligibility criteria so that an invitation to apply for the scholarship is issued in January
Respond to the invitation through the JWU Admissions Portal
Submit the Global Impact Statement and two letters of recommendation
existing.selection_notes: Candidates are evaluated and selected by a committee of JWU faculty and staff based on the strength of their academic transcripts, Global Impact Statement and two letters of recommendation.
existing.best_fit: Academically strong incoming international undergraduates who can document leadership through extracurricular, volunteer or entrepreneurial activity and who apply to JWU under an Early Action plan.
existing.notes: Important caveat found during verification: the current live JWU scholarships page no longer lists the JWU Global Full Tuition Scholarship. The award is described in detail on the EducationUSA listing and in the indexed version of JWU's previous scholarships page, so the record is genuine, but a human should confirm with JWU Admissions whether the scheme is still open for the 2027 cycle before promoting the row to active.
existing.duration: Tuition coverage for the degree; JWU does not publish a separate renewal policy for this award on the pages read.
existing.application_period: Invitation-based. Applicants first apply for admission under Early Action 1 or Early Action 2, and only those who meet the eligibility criteria are invited to apply for the scholarship in January. The scholarship deadline is different from the admission application deadline.
existing.deadline_display: Must be invited to apply through the JWU Admissions Portal, and must have a fully complete undergraduate application by the Early Action 2 deadline (January 4, 2026 in the 2026 cycle). Application Process: Apply to JWU for Early Action 1 or Early Action 2. If you meet eligibility criteria, you'll be invited to apply in January.
existing.program_type: Invitation-based, full-tuition university scholarship for new F-1 international undergraduates.
